name: 2027 coverage benchmark — v3
assumptions: Diagnostic comparison only. Same capability-model v2 revision-3 profiles, course budgets, exclusions, duration rules and internal proposals as the recommended plan. Each cohort is optimised in sequence, conditional on the chosen shared learning; this is not a global workforce optimum. Source audience rules are applied, but delivery suitability and learning quality are not optimisation objectives. Do not automatically adopt these selections.

cohorts.name: Foundation — common knowledge

internal.title: AI in our cyber work: colleague showcase
internal.outcomes: Explain one own-domain and one adjacent-domain case, limits and changed human work.

internal.title: Approved platform, architecture and safe use
internal.outcomes: Trace a request across model, tools and data; choose safe inputs and identify the accountable owner.

internal.title: AI limitations, bank attack examples and knowledge check
internal.outcomes: Recognise unsupported output and suspicious content, explain uncertainty, identify the bank attack scenario and choose independent trusted-channel verification or escalation.

internal.title: Overview of AI security risks
internal.owner: Cyber awareness lead + AI security architect
internal.outcomes: Learner categorises short scenarios, explains the consequence and selects the appropriate precaution/escalation. Pilot and assess the module against N5.8 before awarding coverage credit.

cohorts.rationale: Solver-selected coverage benchmark under this profile and budget. This selection has not been endorsed for delivery suitability; review prerequisites, framework overlap and task relevance before use.
cohorts.note: Everyone: common knowledge, including bank-approved uses, limitations, responsible use and AI-enabled threats.

recommendation.message: Optimal coverage within these constraints; ties resolved by hours, then course count.
